notes.title: Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello!
Code Tracer ver3.0.0 is now available with
major improvements!

[u]Renewal of the UI[/u]
Area maps have been added to enhance the game experience,
and the in-game information is now more visible in windows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35814594/a7e35cf345dc32a91db1b6ccbc9835c2cedaf0de.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35814594/c736f7536db1dc4b85ababa21820943839aeca4f.png[/img]
Also, to make the game easier to play,
you can retry the stage or goto next stage
from the result screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35814594/303afbc998574a0ed09b64ff399a87d4eb3950b1.png[/img]

[u]More confortable game play[/u]
Added an effect when the code is cut,
and improved confortablity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35814594/06cf9e8054eb60723dd1644985af13ed95dc143f.png[/img]

[u]Font improvement[/u]
Improved the overall font for easier reading.

[u]New stages[/u]
Added new stages in this major update too.

[u]Others[/u]
・Improved BGM and SE
・Improved HOWTOPLAY
・Improved TIPS function
・Improved button guide

notes.title: Major Update Schedule
notes.content:
Based on the opinions we have received so far,
we will release Code Tracer ver3.0!

P.S.
The update date will be June 26.
Please wait a moment.

notes.title: Bug Fixes etc
notes.content:
[Bug Fixes]
・Fixed a bug at the start of the game.

[Improvement]
・Changed the number of medals required for stage unlocking.

notes.title: Added EASY MODE
notes.content:
[Update]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35814594/f23d4a2724e9aebff5b1a189ff98f076316a9576.png[/img]
・Added EASY MODE
　By turning on the EASY MODE from the option menu,
　You can play the game with no time limit.
　( Instead of making the game easier, you'll no longer get a time bonus. )

[Improvement]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35814594/9937b50d918629b1788bb4a1d2a4bd33a893e762.png[/img]
・Added the adjustment function of BGM and SE.
